senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. גרר) to scrape off, to diminish, deduct.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 29a:34">Snh. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>כל המוסיף גּוֹרֵעַ</he> he who adds (to the truth) diminishes (whoever does too much does too little).

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 28b">R. Hash. 28ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>עובר על בל תִּגְרַע</he> transgresses the law which prohibits diminishing from what the Law prescribes (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 13:1">Deut. XIII, 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00800"><he>בַּל</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Yoma 48a:7">Yoma 48ᵃ</cite> <he>גּוֹרְעִין ומוסיפין ודורשין</he> we may take away (one servile letter from one word of the text) and add it to another and thus interpret the law (e.g. <he>מדם הפר</he> explained as: <he>דם מהפר</he>); <cite ref="Bava Batra 111b">B. Bath. 111ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—
Y. Yeb. VIII, end, 9ᵈ, v. גָּלַע.—[Gen. R. s. 19, a. e. גרעה קומתו, v. גָּוַע.]—Part. pass. גָּרוּעַ inferior. Pl. גְּרוּעִים.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28">Gen. R. s. 28</cite>. [<cite ref="Berakhot 36a:12">Ber. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>ומי גרע</he>, read with Ms. M. <he>גריעי</he>.]

senses.gloss: to deduct from, to calculate the price of redemption in proportion to the years served and those to be served, v. גֵּירוּעַ Kidd. 11ᵇ מַגְרַעַת מפדיונה she makes a deduction from her redemption money; ib. 14ᵇ מגרעת פדיונה she lessens &c.; ib. 16ᵃ מגרע פד׳ (corr. acc.). Y. Kidd. I, 58ᶜ bot.; Y. Shebu. VI, beg. 36ᵈ מגרעת (ב)מעה וכ׳ she redeems herself by deducting a M’ah for each year.

to be deducted, to be redeemed by deducting the compensation for the time served. Y. Kidd. l. c. אם בקשה לִיגָּרֵעַ if the desires a redemption by deduction &c.; Y. Shebu. l. c. למיגרע (read: לֵהִיגָּ׳ or לִיגָּ׳).
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 11b:10">Kidd. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>תִּיגָּרֵעַ עד פרוטה</he> she can redeem herself by deductions until she comes down to a P’rutah.
